records.Name: Salesforce Portfolio App
records.Technologies__c: Apex, LWC, Named Credentials, Custom Metadata, GitHub Actions
records.Description__c: Personal portfolio as a native Salesforce app: custom objects, layered Apex and a live GitHub LWC on Home. More case studies can be added as Published records.
records.Problem__c: A résumé alone cannot prove Apex architecture, LWC, integrations or test discipline to a Salesforce hiring manager.
records.Solution__c: A deployable SFDX app with a REST callout, trigger handler, tests and CI.
records.Architecture__c: LWC portfolioHome and githubRepos → Apex controllers → GitHubService (Named Credential + CMT). Trigger → Handler → Domain. Selector for published projects on Home.
